draft_args.prompt: [Look: 1970s hotel lobby ad.] [An invented porter in a faded burgundy porter uniform with brass buttons lifts a suitcase that is clearly far too light; at 4 s he tosses it in the air and catches it on one finger; at 8 s he sets it on a trolley, eyes on the trolley.] Single shot: medium shot, 35mm, eye level, static camera, one continuous 10 s take. Eyelines: everyone looks at the product and each other, never into the lens; faces in profile or three-quarter. Motion carries on through the last half second. [Adults only, no kids. Invented characters; a named real person becomes only their moves and attitude, never their likeness. No gore; bloodstains on clothing are fine, no blood draining out. Nobody looks into the camera. Parody brands only; no real brands or personal names on screen.]
